feature: Full-screen overlay with header, stat strip and tab strip fixed above a scrolling body
detail: PlayerViewModal (src/components/players/player-view-modal.tsx) is already a full-screen sheet on phones, but one overflow-y-auto wraps the whole view. Split the header and strips out of the scroller and remove the dialog animation.

feature: Team-coloured header with close chip, action pill, + List pill, injury pill, 64px ringed headshot, name / position / team line / bio line
detail: All data exists: NFL_TEAM_COLORS (hexes match the spec), players.status / jersey_number / experience_years / birth_date / height / weight, STATUS_CHIPS, PlayerAvatarImage ring, AddToListPopover, LeagueCardActions (Drop / trade / one '+' for add or claim, D481). Needs the mobile layout and the light-team text switch for PIT/NO.

feature: Stat strip: position rank, Avg pts, season pts, Bye
detail: core-stats route returns pos_rank, avg_points and total_points; players.bye_week holds the real bye (do not copy the spec's generated bye).

feature: Stat strip: Rostered % and weekly change
detail: No rostered-% source exists (players-panel-ops.ts says so; waiver-adds-card.tsx is mock). Needs a roster-% snapshot plus a weekly change.

feature: 6-tab strip (Summary, Game log, Leagues, Transactions, Team, History)
detail: Today it is the calm view plus 4 remembered toggles (SectionToggles, D486(13)); a render test checks there are no tabs. The tab UI is new and conflicts with the desktop no-tabs ruling.

feature: Ownership row with 'Available in N leagues' that opens the Leagues tab
detail: cardLeagueView / whereLine give the owner per league, but GlobalLeaguesExpander counts all leagues, not available ones. Needs a count across useRosters / useLeaguePool.

feature: Key stats section (6 tiles, collapsible)
detail: KeyStatsPanel plus keyStats() (key-stats-ops.ts) give six position tiles from stored or derived values. Restyle as a 3-column grid with a collapse chevron.

feature: Spec's advanced key stats (aDOT, CPOE, Sack %, Route %, Air yds share, YPRR, Rush share, RZ touches/att/tgt, YCO/att, RYOE, Pressure %, Team RZ trips, Indoor games, 50+ att)
detail: F578: red-zone, routes, snap count and FG long are not stored; player_usage has only season snap_pct and target_share. Needs a tracking/charting feed (for example player_stats.advanced).

feature: Key stat 'last 3' trend arrows
detail: Can be derived from weekly player_stats rows (stats route gameLog). Decide how to colour lower-is-better stats.

feature: Games and projections horizontal card scroller (Wk 1-18 plus bye, prev/next, starts at the prior week, played / current / upcoming / bye states, stat line)
detail: Same data as SeasonTable: scheduleRows / thisWeek / seasonTable, core-stats weekly {points, proj}, useNflTeamSchedule (kickoff_at), useDefenseSplits (OPRK, bands as ruled in D486(16)), gameLog stats for the stat line. The card UI is new.

feature: Current-week 'Points so far' and live/final game string
detail: player_stats.is_live / game_clock and nfl_games quarter / game_clock / scores exist, but core-stats weekly leaves out live weeks (R1506). The route needs to return partial points.

feature: Projections for every upcoming week
detail: player_weekly_projections is synced only for planned weeks (sync-weekly-projections.ts). Far-future weeks will have no projection; leave it out rather than seeding a value.

feature: Recent news card
detail: F575: no player-news source in the schema or sync; the Home injury news card is mock data. Needs an RSS/YouTube feed keyed to players.

feature: News 'Analysis' box and app-written news text
detail: The injury and stat-recap variants could be templated from players.injury_* and stored stats, but D486 says the view never writes advice of its own. Needs a ruling.

feature: Game log year chips (2026/2025/2024) and multi-season logs
detail: The stats route reads only the 2026 game log and 2025 totals; player_stats 2022-2025 is loaded by scripts/load-historical-stats.py. Extend the read; no schema change.

feature: Shared grouped stats table (sticky first column, group headers, tinted cells)
detail: GameLogPanel (Fantasy/NFL toggle) and positionColumns() exist. Rebuild as one grouped table; use core-stats weekly for Fpts so it matches the strip (F576).

feature: Game log weekly position rank column
detail: computePoolStandings(…, season, week) in core-stats-service can rank each week; needs per-week computing and caching.

feature: Game log weekly Snap % column
detail: F578: Sleeper off_snp is not stored per week; only the season player_usage.snap_pct exists.

feature: Game log opponent column for past seasons
detail: Needs nfl_games and defense_position_splits rows for 2024/2025, synced with the existing jobs (sync-nflverse.ts <season>, sync-splits). Otherwise leave the column out.

feature: Leagues tab rows (your team / rostered by @mgr / free agent / on waivers)
detail: LeagueAvailabilityRow plus poolRows availability already compute each state and route to the league's actions.

feature: Leagues tab pre-draft row ('ADP 52 · Draft Aug 28') and 'Add to queue'
detail: players.adp, settings draft_scheduled_at and league status exist; useDraftQueue / useUpdateDraftQueue exist but are used only in the draft room (DraftCardActions). Needs a league to draft and team lookup.

feature: Propose trade opens the trade builder over the profile
detail: tradesHref() goes to the /app/leagues/[id]/trades page (trade-builder.tsx). Mobile wants it stacked over the profile, with Send closing both.

feature: Transactions tab: per-player history across leagues with league filter chips
detail: transactions (payload, type) and draft_picks (round, price) hold the data, but GET /api/leagues/[id]/activity has no player filter and /transactions is POST-only. Add a player filter or a new read; no schema change.

feature: History tab: one-league transactions section and career table (Gm, Fpts, Std/PPR rank, season sums)
detail: player_stats 2022-2025 exists; ranks can come from computePoolStandings per season; transactions as above. Extend the stats route.

feature: History career table: Team column per season
detail: player_stats has no team column and players.team is current-only. Either store team per season or accept the prototype's current-team shortcut (product call).

feature: Team tab: team rank tiles (Offense, Pass yds, Pass att, Pass TD, Rush yds, Total TD, Red zone)
detail: No team-offence stats table; player_stats has no team column; no red-zone data. Needs a team-stats sync or aggregate.

feature: Team tab: depth chart (QB / RB / WR1-3 / TE / K × 3, ages, profiled player highlighted)
detail: players.depth_chart_position / depth_chart_order (migration 029, Sleeper sync) exist and today show only as a tag in players-spreadsheet.tsx. Map LWR/RWR/SWR to WR1-3; ages from birth_date.

feature: Toast over the profile
detail: use-toast exists. The spec says 1800ms and the README says about 2.2s; pick one.

feature: Tap opens the profile directly (no mini card)
detail: use-open-player.ts opens the mini card first on every click (D494, 'mini card, then full'). Does mobile skip it?

feature: Dark mode (profile tokens and the PIT/NO header problem)
detail: CLAUDE.md says single theme, but worktree HEAD 27d455b adds m-* light/dark tokens, a mob: variant and theme-store noting 'Dark mode is mobile-only (Chris, 2026-10-15)'. Confirm that ruling replaces CLAUDE.md, and fix rather than copy the white-on-gold PIT/NO header.

feature: League context for the header action, ownership row and History transactions
detail: The prototype always uses league 0 and ignores the selected league; the app uses the leagueId context or a global list. Which league applies on mobile?

feature: Scoring basis for the strip, cards and game log
detail: The app has a scoring dropdown (ESPN Standard default, the selected league, or a remembered choice, D486(11)); the mobile spec has no picker. Where does it go, and does the selected league's scoring win?

feature: Mobile layout (tabs) vs desktop calm view with toggles
detail: D486(13) ruled progressive disclosure with no tabs. Confirm mobile is meant to diverge.

feature: 'All leagues' copy when available in 0 leagues
detail: Reads as 'available everywhere' but means 'nowhere'; the spec flags it for the product owner.

feature: Profile layout with the leagues flag off (free-only launch)
detail: featureFlags.leagues is off in production; the spec has no layout without leagues (Leagues / Transactions tabs, ownership row, header action, History transactions).
